rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: AI Data Access Gateway is an MCP server that sits between AI agents and databases, providing governed read-only data access with SQL safety checks, field-level authorization policies, data masking, and audit logging. It exposes a FastMCP streamable HTTP endpoint and includes an admin console for managing data sources, governance policies, and access logs. The server prevents unsafe or unauthorized queries while giving agents structured access to database content.
